## Ease  (type-only)
type Ease = (t: number) => number;

## SpringEase  (type-only)
interface SpringEase {
    readonly kind: 'spring';
    readonly stiffness: number;
    readonly damping: number;
}

## Tween  (type-only)
interface Tween {
    readonly progress: number;
    readonly elapsed: number;
    readonly duration: number;
    readonly complete: boolean;
    readonly killed: boolean;
    readonly paused: boolean;
    timeScale: number;
    pause(): void;
    resume(): void;
    kill(): void;
    restart(): void;
    then(fn: () => void): Tween;
    promise(): Promise<void>;
}

## TweenOptions  (type-only)
interface TweenOptions {
    ease?: Ease | SpringEase;
    delay?: number;
    loops?: number;
    yoyo?: boolean;
    onStart?: (tween: Tween) => void;
    onUpdate?: (tween: Tween) => void;
    onComplete?: (tween: Tween) => void;
    timeScale?: number;
}

## TweenProps  (type-only)
type TweenProps = Record<string, number>;

## Tweens
class Tweens implements TweenOwner {
    get active(): number;
    update(dt: number): void;
    to(target: object, props: TweenProps, seconds: number, opts?: TweenOptions): Tween;
    value(from: number, to: number, seconds: number, onUpdate: (value: number, tween: Tween) => void, opts?: TweenOptions): Tween;
    delay(seconds: number, opts?: TweenOptions): Tween;
    sequence(...tweens: (Tween | TweenOptions)[]): Tween;
    parallel(...tweens: (Tween | TweenOptions)[]): Tween;
    kill(target: object): void;
    killAll(): void;
    readd(t: TweenBase): void;
}

## createTweens
function createTweens(): Tweens;
